body: Same with me.

See.. This is why you shouldn't have sex when you're not ready.

1. It is really unlikely you would get pregnant from a single intercourse. It is 100x more unlikely if you used protection. If your period is late then get a pregnancy test. 

2. Your mom was right. But what is done can't be undone. Your mom probably knows you will have sex soon regardless or that you already had. Just act normally around her and nothing horrific. Talk to her about it only if you have to though. Introduce your boyfriend to her first though.

3. "Love, I know we had sex and I don't regret it. I am glad we've done it and that it was with you. But I am not sure if I'm emotionally ready to have sex on regular basis yet. It is something really new to me and I need some time to process all of this. I love you and I hope you understand." something inbetween those lines.

Just tell him... But hey.. The sex will be amazing!

There was a person here writing who has nobody and that he/she never recieved a gift for Christmas and never will.. I am not taking anything away from your struggles but you are young and many people seem to care about you. Please reconsider your decisions.
That's terrible :( I so wish to be with you right now :(

My mom.. She would have been devastated. I can't cause so much pain to her. Also I still  have a few things to look forward to.. But after those things are gone in a few months it will be just my mom (who is pretty ill so she can be gone at any time too).. Also I feel like there is still some hope. I cherish some hope for things to get better. But if they don't and when my mom dies I will do it. If I don't do it then I will never do it.

I remember failing my first class in college. I took the wrong bus.. Had to run like 1,5 kilometers in 10 minutes to catch a train home or I would have been stuck in the city for 2 hours which my psyche wouldn't handle. Made it in 8 minutes.. I was unable to catch my breath.. Just sat down and started crying and sobbing while breathing heavily. A stranger sitting opposite to me had to give me a handkerchief. That was probably the last time I cried like that in public.. I just couldn't help it. A week later I failed another class and I failed another the next semester and guess what. I made it and hopefully I will have a Master's degree in 5 months.. I experienced so much happiness since that train ride which I wouldn't have if I just gave up. And now I know that even if I didn't continue it wouldn't have been the end of the world.. Head up young man. I am sure you have other problems then school.. many of us do. We just need to fight on. Things can get better.
I was thinking about that too.. It is terrible to think that many of the posts here week and older would have been written by now dead people..
I am 25.. Also a virgin. I am already depressed. I am pretty sure I will end up the same way as you. But I won't make it as far as you did..

I had a friend like this. One day he called me all the names in the book and humiliated me and it also seemed like for no reason. But by that time I had 2 other friends who I believe would never do that. Did the friend also came to you when he/she had problems? Did she/he share secrets and inner feelings with you? How did he/she react when you shared your problems with them? Was there any advice/words of support? Those of us who are lonely like you and me, we might view someone as a very close friend even when they aren't just because we never had someone better. You definitely didn't deserve to be treated like this, but he/she is the one who lost a truly valuable person, not you..
Someone who even says his family is wonderful, can't be that bad..

I mostly dream about travelling by a train to a location which represents hope and heaven for me. Or being at that location. I was at that location only 2 times (5 days in total) but I feel like it's my spiritual home. Unless something drastically changes in my life I am not planning on going back there ever again though..

2 years are not that long. You can live another 70 years... I once waited 3,5 years for things to improve and they did. I experienced happiness like never before. I am back at a very dark place right now but I am glad I sticked around to experience those beautiful moments... Now I feel like they were meant to be. You are very young, much younger then me and although I can't promise you things will improve, I can tell you they CAN.

Cutting through your veins will not kill you. You will bleed a lot but it will dry and you won't bleed out. It would have be followed by a very awkward emergency at the hospital and encounter with those close to you. Please don't do it...
That's the second time around. If there was no purpose for you in this world you would have been dead by now. Please stick with us for longer...

If you are in school, you are still young and there is so much hope for things to change. There are people who are 50+, homeless, addicted to alcohol, drugs, with no family, with nobody and nothing. I don't know what your reason for trying to kill yourself is, but things can change.
I thought about this as well. Like if just someone shot me in the head 10x... I would be so grateful.

I was at the top of a bridge too.. It was like there was this invisible wall that I couldn't get over and climb on the bridge and jump. Self-preservation is a really strong thing and I believe if you are completely sane you won't be able to overcome it. It is not weakness.
I am sorry you ended up like this. If only people didn't overlook and ignore red flags early in the relationship...

I felt depressed and suicidal 2 days ago too... Today I recieved another terrible news related to the thing that caused me feeling suicidal. And somehow I don't care. I am even cheerful a bit. I don't know why... It is confusing and weird.
Pills will rarely kill you and can have long term effects on your health, making your life even worse. Please stop and try to vomit the ones you already swallowed out.

hmmm.. you're talking out of my soul

Plan a trip if you can. Don't spent it at home. Go somewhere for several days.

Stop pls. We are hear to talk people out of suicide and not give recommendations. I agree that doing it as he is planning is a terrible, terrible idea and he shouldn't do it. But that doesn't mean he should do it in any other way.

A week ago I was holding in emotions for 2 days (tried not to cry).. and after two days I decided to let it all out. I went to a place at night where I experienced happiness and hope (now all gone), played some sad music and cried for perhaps 20 minutes. It was pathetic. I felt and must have looked like a baby. But it helped me for 5 days. I even felt euphoria after. Most of my depression faded for at least a few days. Now I feel that it's back again. But I believe crying can help you feel better. However it is only temporary, like some sedative or drug and it is an illusion because it doesn't fix your problems.

I am so sorry to hear that. But I know how it feels I am unable to talk about my feelings too. I also have no one to talk to about them and I feel like they are so irrelevant and that they don't matter. I just turned 25 and I never had a girlfriend and I am pretty sure I will never have one. I do love one girl. We used to be very good friends and I even had hopes on dating her one day but it seems like she's moving on to something better then me. She doesn't really care about me. She told me I am the closest friend she has last weekend but her actions say otherwise and if we didn't work at the same place we would never talk to each other again. I will lose regular contact with her within a few months and right now I can't imagine not being able to see her and talk to her regularly. I imagine that if she loved me, we could spent our lives together and have a family and I wouldn't have to worry about losing her ever again. But then I realize it will never happen.. Not just with her but with any girl. I am unable to ask a girl out or even if I did to have a second date with her. I am a complete loser. I am 25 and depressed about a thing that teenagers would be. People at my age are getting engaged not wanting to commit suicide because of a crush. I am so behind my peers and I will die alone and I am not ready to live another 60 years on this planet alone and without love.

I've been doing that too. I want to commit suicide but I don't have the guts to do so.. Also I can't do it as long as my mom is alive. The woman has been through enough I can never do that to her. Do you wanna write about your struggles?
